description: On the E007 Muon incumbent at 9.0 epochs, remove Lookahead and replace the triangular warmup+decay schedule with linear decay from peak to 0, with no warmup, for both the Muon and SGD groups. That is airbench94_muon style. Keep lr, momentum, batch and epochs fixed. Make the change in one run, because both components are SGD-era carryovers.
